sections.name: summary
sections.value: Solo PM delivery for plan 132: RED witnesses, additive spawn bind reporting, parent preservation, deterministic and live proof, review.

value.title: Establish RED-first spawn and dead-recipient witnesses
value.success: Child-exit, parent-loss, bound missing-pane, and tombstoned-recipient behavior fail before implementation.

value.title: Implement bind reporting and full dead-recipient terminalization
value.success: Spawn reports bind or named failure; every tombstoned or tmux-absent recipient leaves named terminal queue state on the next drain tick; parent is preserved.

value.title: Prove and review composed behavior
value.success: Deterministic checks, live proof, and cross-model review are complete.

tk-a132.assertion: The child-exit, parent-preservation, bound missing-pane, and tombstoned-recipient terminal-state witnesses fail on the pre-fix tree.

tk-b132.assertion: Spawn separates dispatched from bound, returns early-exit evidence, emits spawn.bound/spawn.failed, preserves parent, and terminalizes every pending row for a tombstoned or tmux-absent recipient with a named failed outcome and no retry.
tk-b132.receipt: pointer worker: 27 passed including global inventory failure RED/GREEN; production copy: 72 dead pending before, 0 after one cadence; R2 R001/R002/R006/R009 closed, N1 fixed for R3

tk-c132.assertion: Focused Rust tests, full gates, healthy plus failing live tmux transcripts, a production-copy dead-recipient drain, and cross-model review prove all acceptance criteria.
